description: This file defines the 'SugarWidgetSubPanelDeleteButton' class, which extends 'SugarWidgetField' and provides a method to render a delete button for subpanel entries in the SugarCRM/SuiteCRM interface. It includes logic for generating HTML with JavaScript hooks for deletion confirmation and handling different modules.

classes.name: SugarWidgetSubPanelDeleteButton
classes.description: A widget class responsible for rendering delete buttons in subpanels, with logic tailored to different modules and layout definitions.

methods.name: displayList
methods.description: Generates HTML for a delete link in a subpanel, incorporating module-specific behavior and JavaScript hooks for confirmation and deletion actions.
